staff.title: Staff
staff.intro: Staff accounts, their roles and their sign-in set-up.
staff.addButton: Add and create a set-up link

roles.title: Roles
roles.intro: Which permissions each role has. You can only give or take away permissions you have yourself.
roles.name: Name
roles.ownerNote: The owner role has every permission and cannot be edited.

common.forbidden: You do not have permission to see this.
common.conflict: Someone else changed this. Reload and try again.
common.reason: Reason (optional, kept in the audit log)

staff.signInIntro: Sign in with your email, password and authenticator app.
staff.codeIntro: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
staff.invalidCredentials: The email or password is not right.
staff.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
staff.expired: Your sign-in step has expired. Start again.

enrol.title: Set up your staff account
enrol.intro: Choose a password and connect an authenticator app. You need this link once; it then stops working.
enrol.missingLink: This set-up link is missing, used or expired. Ask an owner for a new one.
enrol.secretHelp: Add this key to an authenticator app, or open the link below on your phone, then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
enrol.invalidCode: That code is not right. Check the time on your phone and try again.
enrol.recoveryHelp: Each code works once if you lose your phone. Keep them somewhere safe: they will not be shown again.

stepUp.title: Confirm it's you
stepUp.help: This action needs a fresh code from your authenticator app.
stepUp.revoked: Too many wrong codes. Sign in again.

customer.signInIntro: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to sign in. No password needed.
customer.sent: If that address can sign in, a link is on its way. It works once and expires in 15 minutes.
customer.invalidLink: This sign-in link has expired or has already been used.
